notes: Exercises the read-and-echo log loop at the tail of wps_psend. The original receives the log from `powershell.exe ... > c:/temp/ps_pgm.log`; here we fabricate a small log file (the OUTPUT block from section 1 of the main script) and run the same INFILE/INPUT/PUT _INFILE_ + PUTLOG _INFILE_ idiom that the macro uses to surface the captured stdout.
